records.text: In the first quarter of 2025, the Company generated revenues of $6.4 billion, an increase of $9 million compared to the first quarter of 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We see several supply and demand factors driving downward pressure on oil prices, including the impact from announced plans for increased production by the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries and its allies ("OPEC+") and uncertainty around trade policy and tariffs affecting global GDP and oil demand.
